principle: Technology availability is resolved from civilization/operator, era/date, platform/configuration, authorization and live condition.
rules: A technology known somewhere in the galaxy is not automatically available to every faction or platform.
Era matrix sets an upper bound unless explicit experimental/special provenance overrides it.
Platform definitions may narrow but not silently exceed applicable technology context.
Damage, power, resources or authorization may make an installed capability temporarily unavailable.
AI cannot grant technology because a narrative outcome would be convenient.
